geen afvalstoffen meer binnen de inrichting te accepteren zolang onvoldoende is geborgd dat nieuw geaccepteerd afval het aanwezige afvalwater niet verontreinigt
rationale: This Dutch Raad van State decision concerns a provincial administrative enforcement order (last onder bestuursdwang) following a fire (ongewoon voorval) in a pile of solid commercial waste at a waste-processing facility, requiring removal of burned solid waste and suspending acceptance of new solid waste until compliant floor storage is ensured and incoming waste cannot contaminate wastewater present on site (such as pooled firefighting water). The primary dispute involves solid-waste facility fire remediation under general environmental law rather than water law, water governance, wastewater discharge permitting, or water utility services.
